# Embedded-Python sites check.sh's extractor cannot reach — checked in, because
# a blind spot nobody wrote down is indistinguishable from one that does not
# exist. Entries are matched by file and kind, not by line, so ordinary edits
# above them do not churn this file; a SECOND unreachable site of the same kind
# in the same file still fails, because the count has to match too.
#
# heredoc-expanded: the marker is unquoted (`python3 << PYEOF`), so the shell
# expands $vars before python ever sees it. What is on disk is a template, not
# a program, and compiling it would be checking something that never runs.
# Quoting the marker would make these reachable — that is a real fix, not done
# here because it changes runtime behaviour and belongs in its own change.
#
# Verify a line is still needed:  ./scripts/check.sh   (a stale entry fails too)
setup.sh [heredoc-expanded]
lib/sync/skills.sh [heredoc-expanded]
